title: Liquid Glass custom action inputs
description: Structural preflight for supported custom primitive calls. It performs no UI action and does not establish authorization, contextual validity or accepted state. Exact tuples describe the supported agent interface; JavaScript may tolerate ignored extra arguments. SDK alias actions inherit their installed upstream contracts. x-invalidExamples documents rejected invocation shapes and is not a JSON Schema assertion keyword.

liquid-viewport.description: Supported agent invocation shape. Requests still pass through the actual viewport primitive and controlled host.

prefixItems.description: Finite requested camera values. Positive zoom requests are clamped by the runtime to 0.1–4; this input schema does not falsely reject supported out-of-range requests.

oneOf.description: Request the complete camera; observe the accepted, possibly clamped result.

x-invalidExamples.reason: Coordinate exceeds the accepted absolute bound.

oneOf.description: Pan by finite deltas; the resulting camera may still be refused by its bounds or host.
Request a positive zoom; the SDK clamps accepted output to 0.1–4.
Multiply the current zoom; observe the clamped accepted output.
Fit document bounds in the mounted surface.
Request zoom 1 around the current surface.
Fit the current selection; no selection can produce no change.
Set the shared pan interaction mode.
Request expanded state through the controlled host callback.

model-document.description: Supported agent invocation shape. Current revision, IDs, geometry, cross-view rules, host policy and controlled acceptance remain runtime checks. The runtime additionally limits transactions to 1 MB UTF-8 JSON and 40 levels, rejects prototype-changing keys, and measures text limits in UTF-16 code units.
